rca of the issue: Iter13's admin-sample-missing FAIL RCA: identity resolver in server.py startup seeded only DEMO_IDENTITIES (4 emails), not the admin identity from env. Fix (verified this iter): resolver now unions DEMO_IDENTITIES ∪ {ADMIN_EMAIL from env} ∪ {'master@rms.example.com' fallback}. Seeder is idempotent because it upserts on session_id fixed prefix ('s-sample-in-progress-'+identity, 's-sample-ready-'+identity) — restart re-runs the seed loop but the upsert-by-id ensures per-identity sample count stays at (1 in_progress, 1 ready). Iter13's refusal-prose-not-interactive FAIL RCA: verdict panel rendered route as plain <span>. Fix (verified): resolveApprovalDestination() maps route text substrings ('countersign'→/govern/pending, 'change-a-rule'→/govern/change-rule, 'retention'→/govern/retention, 'team'→/team, default→/govern/pending) and renders a react-router <Link> with data-testid='use-data-verdict-refusal-route-affordance' (escalatable) or '-held-route-affordance' (held); prose sentence retained separately as -route-label. Refused-absolute path renders neither testid — zero-affordance invariant preserved.
